instruction: Use command-line automation only to operate the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment through the CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying. For this task, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\slot_plate.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. In the 120 x 80 x 10 mm part, machine the centered 40 x 8 mm through obround slot as a native 2.5-axis pocket process. Use T1, a 6 mm flat end mill, at S8500 rpm and F500 mm/min for material-cutting XY moves; a lower controlled plunge feed is allowed. The part setup is G54 with its origin at model coordinates [0, 0, 10] mm and tool axis -Z, so the top is posted Z=0 and the through-slot bottom is posted Z=-10 mm. Generate a complete area-clearing path with safe approach and retract, then post-process it with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM postprocessor. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-02.nc.
source: Installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks API; official SOLIDWORKS CAM product and training documentation: https://www.solidworks.com/product/solidworks-cam ; https://www.solidworks.com/support/training/solidworks-cam-standard
